purpose: Map missing ideas, intents, and execution outcomes into the Research Runtime object graph.

primary_intents.meaning: Convert vague research ideas into explicit uncertainty statements.
Capture what work was performed and bind it to evidence.
Turn validated research or learning into a reusable asset.
Connect assets to offers, buyers, revenue models and product paths.
Separate tax, grant, IP and governance evidence from marketing narrative.
Generate an executive, research, asset, commercial and audit pack from the graph.

missing_idea_rules: Any note without an uncertainty becomes a draft question.
Any question without a hypothesis remains partial.
Any asset without evidence is commercial-only until provenance is attached.
Any claim without grade A or B evidence is partial.
Any revenue idea without buyer and price point remains speculative.
Any reusable learning must be linked to at least one target brand, product or workflow.

classification.PARTIAL: Structured but missing execution, evidence, deployment or receipt.
classification.BLOCKED: Missing authority, dependency, credential, or runtime surface.
